task: Task 11 — P2 quarantine, client projection, legacy-route containment
policy: Every reachable build/export/download surface plus profile/tool/policy/JWT/storage-signing authority input is inventoried. A human or client can never reach P2 plaintext, a raw storage locator, or a reusable signed URL, and only one mutable release authority (0182 release_revision, reached via the V3 edge) exists. Dispositions: REUSE non-authoritative primitive | ADAPT reused under V3 contract | READ_ONLY history/inspection with no production-shaped output | BLOCK client download / FROZEN manufacturing export / duplicate authority / any bypass.

forbidden.description: The client never sends an actor role/name header (client role cannot be authority — design §7.1).

The edge never accepts a client-built P2 packet upload (no dual write).
The packet hook never triggers a client-side P2 ZIP download.
